title: Hussain Kehte the zainab mujhe sawar karo
body:
HUSSAIN KEHTE THE ZAINAB MUJHE SAWAAR KARO
<<DIVIDER>>
MUJHE BHI NANA KI UMMAT PE AB NISAAR KARO
WO MERI YAAD MEIN ROYEGI KHOON KEY AANSU… WO MERI YAAD MEIN ROYEGI KHOON KEY AANSU… MERI TARAF SE SAKINA KO…..
MERI TARAF SE SAKINA KO, MERI PYAAR KARO
<<MINI>>
HUSSAIN KEHTE THE ZAINAB MUJHE SAWAAR KARO
<<DIVIDER>>
HARAM KO LOOT KEY QAIMEI LAAIYE JALAYENGEY… HARAM KO LOOT KEY QAIMEI LAAIYE JALAYENGEY… QASAM HAI TUMKO BAHEN SABR…..
QASAM HAI TUMKO BAHEN SABR, EQTIYAAR KARO
<<MINI>>
HUSSAIN KEHTE THE ZAINAB MUJHE SAWAAR KARO
<<DIVIDER>>
SUKUN SOYENGEY ASGHAR HAMARE SEENE PAR… SUKUN SOYENGEY ASGHAR HAMARE SEENE PAR… TUM UNKI YAAD MEIN DIL KO NA…..
TUM UNKI YAAD MEIN DIL KO NA, BEKARAR KARO
MADA KEY WASTE BABA KO JAB PUKAROGI… MADA KEY WASTE BABA KO JAB PUKAROGI… ZAROOR AYENGEY BABA KA…..
ZAROOR AYENGEY BABA KA, INTEZAAR KARO
<<MINI>>
HUSSAIN KEHTE THE ZAINAB MUJHE SAWAAR KARO
<<DIVIDER>>
SAKINA DHOONDTI MAQTAL MEIN MUJHKO AYENGI… SAKINA DHOONDTI MAQTAL MEIN MUJHKO AYENGI… BAHEN HAMARI WASIYATH KA…..
BAHEN HAMARI WASIYATH KA, ETEBAAR KARO
<<MINI>>
HUSSAIN KEHTE THE ZAINAB MUJHE SAWAAR KARO
<<DIVIDER>>
HAMARE RANJ-O-MASAYEB SUNA KEY AYE MAZHAR… HAMARE RANJ-O-MASAYEB SUNA KEY AYE MAZHAR… HAMARE CHAHANE WALAO KO…..
HAMARE CHAHANE WALAO KO, ASHK BAAR KARO
<<MINI>>
HUSSAIN KEHTE THE ZAINAB MUJHE SAWAAR KARO
